stemBlocks: Which of the following statements is/are correct?

1 Among individuals 1, 2, 3 and 4, there must be 4 recessive alleles.
2 The probability of individual 5 having gained the recessive allele from individual 1 is 25% because each parent has two alleles.
3 If one body cell is taken from each of the seven individuals, the difference between the theoretical maximum number of recessive alleles present and the theoretical minimum number is two.
